modelingNotes: Manufacturer spelling LC1D1156P7 corresponds to the source presentation LC1-D1156P7; exact P7 order retained, no successor substitution.

Exact Schneider sheet dated 2023-04-13: https://docs.rs-online.com/31e6/0900766b810195d5.pdf. Three main NO poles, factory 1 NO + 1 NC auxiliary contacts, 230 V AC 50/60 Hz coil, power lugs/bars and control ring lugs.

B8 catalog pp. B8/10 and B8/79 establishes lug variant selection and applicable terminal scheme: https://iportal2.schneider-electric.com/Contents/docs/B8_CONTACTORS_EN_CATALOGUE.PDF. Keys 13/NO and 21/NC retain its annotations; manual numeric 13 and 21 identify the same endpoints.

Built-in bidirectional peak-limiting diode suppression belongs to the coil. Detailed suppression circuitry is documented only as a coil property, not separately rendered or treated as a fixed link. AC coil has no assigned DC polarity.
All contact functions share coil actuation. Mechanical relations, closed NC state and coil impedance create no permanent net continuity. No factory fixed links are asserted.

Contact ratings depend on use: 115 A AC-3/AC-3e or 200 A AC-1 at <=440 V and ambient <60 degrees C. Power capability <=1000 V AC 25-400 Hz or <=300 V DC is not nominal circuit voltage. No scalar contact rating assigned.

All twelve documented circuit endpoints are included. Exact physical clamping/access-position census and any duplicate coil access are unverified. Manual p.3 illustrates relocation of the coil, not multiple installed coil pairs. No optional add-on contacts or undocumented bonding interfaces are modeled.
Passive contacts are application-dependent; A1/A2 are required by library policy for electrical coil operation. Every contact and coil function maps to an existing circuit symbol.

connectionCoverage.notes: Twelve documented circuit endpoints covered. Exhaustive physical clamping/access inventory, including any duplicated coil access, is not established. Built-in suppression is retained in coil notes; detailed semiconductor circuit is not rendered. Optional accessories excluded.
